messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Pager: service=redwood-embedder region=us-east-1 severity=sev2  error-rate 5m avg > 8%  auto-fallback executed

Priya Patel: I'm on-call. seeing sharp spike in 502s for /v1/embeddings. fallback to embed-lite happened but heavy tail remains. tagging Mateo for handoff.

Mateo Ramos: Taking this. quick triage question: any recent deploys to embedder canary or runtime tweaks?

Priya Patel: yes, a quantized bundle pushed ~2h ago to canary (embed-v3q). logs show repeated KV eviction churn and occasional OOMs on gpu-pool-3 nodes.

Jin Park: adding context: that bundle changes internal TTL scaling for prefix cache. I pushed a runtime tweak that might interpret multiplier units wrong between ms/s.

Kara Liu: customer-impact: flagged 3 enterprise accounts and one support escalation where requests timed out. I'm opening customer tickets and marking impacted accounts.

Mateo Ramos: immediate plan: 1) scale up gpu-pool-3 by +2 pods 2) disable prefix-KV for embed-v3q temporarily 3) route high-SLA traffic to embed-fallback 4) collect heap and kv metrics. doing 1 and 2 now.

Priya Patel: scaling command issued?

Mateo Ramos: `kubectl -n inference scale deploy gpu-pool-3 --replicas=8`  applied, awaiting new pods.

incident-bot: K8s event: deployment/gpu-pool-3 scaled -> 8 replicas (by Mateo Ramos)

Jin Park: flipped config: model-serve-config:embed-v3q -> enable_prefix_kv=false. rolling-restart of affected pods started.

Priya Patel: error-rate dropped from 9.6% to ~2.3% after rolling restart and scaling. latency still elevated for inputs with >1024 tokens.

Kara Liu: informed customers: status update sent, fallback in place, investigating root cause. no SLA credits yet, will advise after PIR.

Mateo Ramos: heapdumps and profiles uploaded: s3://redwood-dumps/2143654321/heap-*.gz

Jin Park: quick grep of heap dumps: two canary pods show sustained KV cache growth due to TTL not expiring. looks like the runtime parsed a TTL multiplier as seconds instead of milliseconds in the quantized path.

Priya Patel: severity call: partial customer impact, mitigated in ~20m by scaling+fallback. recommend SEV2 and a PIR.

Kara Liu: scheduling PIR for tomorrow 10:00 PT. owners: Jin (RCA + PR), Mateo (mitigation timeline + runbook), Priya (customer impact + support follow-up).

Priya Patel: calendar invite: "PIR: embed-v3q cache TTL regression" 10:00-11:00 PT (tentative).

Mateo Ramos: proposed follow-up action items (to add to remediation tracker):
- A1: Fix TTL multiplier parsing bug in quant runtime (owner: Jin)  estimate: small (1 dev-day)
- A2: Unit tests covering TTL parsing and end-to-end canary with long sequences (owner: Jin)  estimate: small (0.5 dev-day)
- A3: Add metric and alert for KV cache growth per-pool and lower default cache floor for canaries (owner: Mateo)  estimate: medium (2-3 dev-days)
- A4: Update oncall runbook: embedder OOM checklist + quick rollback flag (owner: Mateo)  estimate: small (1-2 dev-days)
- A5: Customer communication package + credit calc template (owner: Kara)  estimate: small (1 dev-day)

Jin Park: adding A6: extend canary observation window for quantized bundles from 30m to 2h for models sensitive to sequence-length distribution (owner: Jin)  estimate: small (0.5 dev-day)

Kara Liu: product tie-in: mark A3 as a Reliability Q deliverable and ensure it's included in the quarterly roadmap for the Reliability pillar.

Priya Patel: prioritization rules recap: SEV1 -> P0 immediate; SEV2 w/systemic fix needed -> P1, but bump to P0 if >3 enterprise customers affected. This incident touches 3 flagged customers; recommend A3 be P0 for the quarter.

Mateo Ramos: I'll log these as issues in tracker and size them. Suggested sizing mapping: small=3pt, medium=8pt, large=20pt. I'll assign A1/A2/A4/A6 to current sprint; A3 as P0 for next sprint; A5 to ops next week.

Jin Park: prepping PR: "fix(runtime): ttl multiplier parsing for quant path (INC-2143654321)" referencing heapdumps and RCA. aiming to have PR + brief RCA in tracker by 08:00 PT tomorrow.

incident-bot: Issue created: INC-2143654321  https://tracker.internal/INC-2143654321 (linked by Jin Park)

Kara Liu: PIR deliverables: timeline, mitigation metrics (error-rate/latency before/after), root cause diffs, customer-impact summary, checklist for quantized bundle rollouts.

Priya Patel: Jin, please have code diff and short RCA ready for PIR review.

Jin Park: will post PR and attach heap dumps + minimal RCA before 08:00 PT.

Mateo Ramos: I'll draft runbook updates and attach dashboard snapshots. Also adding a small logging change: emit structured startup log for TTL values with units to improve debugging.

incident-bot: Incident status updated -> mitigated (SEV2). All actions tracked in INC-2143654321.

Priya Patel: closing pager. thanks all. reconvene at PIR tomorrow.

Kara Liu: thanks team :thumbsup:

Jin Park: thanks, PR incoming."
